items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: That's when Art Tatum was here, and Teddy Wilson, just before Teddy Wilson went to New York.

ctx.x: What were some of those places?

Well, this first place I mentioned, at 55th and the el, that was around back in the thirties. That's when Art Tatum was here, and Teddy Wilson, just before Teddy Wilson went to New York. He was still around. Oh, my God, I don't know. Gang of musicians were around, and most everybody was working. You wasn't making much money, making $2.00, $3.00 a night, but you was working, and people was spending money. Especially, you know, the black population. We didn't suffer too much during the Depression, musicians didn't.
No, I know. Musicians seemed to do better then than later, really.
